tools.name: find_nearest_postboxes
tools.description: Find postboxes near a UK postcode, place name or OS grid reference. Use for location-based discovery (e.g. SW1A 1AA, Edinburgh).

query.description: UK postcode, town, village or OS grid reference.

tools.name: search_from_home
tools.description: Search PostboxMap from the home page. Routes postcodes and place names to nearest postboxes; registration numbers, reign and cypher queries to catalogue search.

query.description: Postcode, place, registration number, reign, cypher or postbox name.

tools.name: search_postboxes
tools.description: Search the UK postbox catalogue by reign, royal cypher, postbox type, subtype or town. Use for reign and type filters (e.g. Victoria, VR, pillar box).

q.description: Free text: town, postbox name or keyword.

reign.description: Monarch reign, e.g. Queen Victoria, Queen Elizabeth II, King Charles III.

type.description: Postbox form, e.g. pillar box, wall box, lamp box.

subtype.description: Subtype within the form, e.g. Penfold, A-type.
